text.text: Supporting the Future of Advanced Air Mobility

Making up for the lack of experience and engineering in this fast growing industry is a challenge, which is why innovators turn to external partners. With decades of experience, MZaero’s specialized engineering team helps aerospace innovators navigate certification and integration to bring visions to reality. As innovators race to revolutionize air travel with Drone, CTOL, STOL, VTOL Aircraft, having safety and design partners is critical. At MZaero, our services exist to accelerate a future of safe, sustainable flight. Backed by decades of experience, our team provides the technical mastery to realize your most ambitious visions.

MZaero offers a team of senior engineers experienced in diverse aerospace projects, ensuring you get application specific support. We specialize in systems integration applications, ensuring technologies work seamlessly from concept to production.
Comprehensive aircraft systems and subsystems engineering
Product liability, risk mitigation, and management
Ongoing certification processes and specifications continue to challenge AAM developers.

Most companies incorporate a 10-9 safety factor using redundancy on system and component reliability. However, redundancy alone cannot mitigate all risks, such as human error, weather, propulsion loss, bird strikes, and others. Developers must include contingencies for situations where redundancy falls short in unpredictable conditions.

In the realm of vertical take-off and landing vehicles, weight is a critical consideration. Embracing lightweight design principles becomes paramount, ensuring a delicate balance between safety and efficiency.

Michael has been involved in aerospace-related product development nearly his entire career, much of it with a specific focus on safety systems, including parachutes, structures, aircraft seating, restraint systems and related electronics. He worked for premier companies including Airbus, BAE Systems, Autoflug, and Siemens Automotive

Nick has a broad range of experience in product development engineering, manufacturing, testing, and regulatory compliance in automotive and aerospace systems in all major markets since 1985. A great deal of Mr. Jaksa’s focus was on crashworthiness and occupant safety in a combination of product development, testing, and product liability defense positions, working for major manufacturing corporations, including Siemens Automotive, Bosch, and Alliedsignal.
